title: First job at house parties and brother's Original Cloverleaf
summary: The first job was a house party for Italian people; he later played a long time in his brother's Original Cloverleaf orchestra.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: I might be able to find that picture in the other room in a few minutes and we can go over that. What was your other bands that you played with? You mentioned the Utilis Gene was your first band. Oh, I played, yeah, and I played in my oldest. About how old were you when you first played? About 19. 19 when you played with them. That was just a four piece. Where did they play? Any special places?
No, just around town, different little house parties, you know. This was for some Italian people we played that night. I always think about my first job.
Yeah, something you usually never forget.
About my brother, we had an orchestra. I played with him for quite a while. It was the original cloverleaf. I played with them.
They call that the original cloverleaf. That was the brother that was the trumpeteer. The trumpeteer. Is he still living? Yeah, he's living. But doesn't play?
He doesn't play anymore. He's sick, you know. I don't think he can be. He tries, but I think he... I don't think he can come up to the stand.
Unless you keep at it all the time, it's hard to keep your lip in shape and all.
